question: The shortest length of the intercept between the x-axis and y-axis of the equation 6x + 8y - 48 = 0 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put y = 0 to find the x-intercept: 6x = 48 ⇒ x = 8.

Put x = 0 to find the y-intercept: 8y = 48 ⇒ y = 6.

The shortest length of the intercept between the axes is the hypotenuse of the right triangle formed.

Length = √(8² + 6²) = √(64 + 36) = √100 = 10 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 units.**
